description: Use this to reproduce what was known about a product at an earlier moment, e.g. when a decision was made: every statement our record held at as_of (a date means the end of that day, Europe/Berlin time), with its statement_id, value, verification_state, confidence_recorded and the sources retrieved by then. It is our record, not the page as it was served; before first_recorded_at nothing is claimed.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone.

attributes.description: "all" (default, same as the REST answer) returns every statement; "documented" omits the unknown ones and counts them in unknown_statements_omitted.

name: get_product_record
title: A product as recorded on a date
